parts.label: (d)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Method 1 — enumerate included scenarios
Both Os with a C: $\binom52=10$; both Os without a C: $\binom52\binom32=30$; one O with a C and one without: $\binom51\binom42=30$; one O with each C: $\binom51\binom41/2!=10$. [B1]
Guidance: Accurately calculate one identified scenario: both Os with a C, both Os without a C, one O with a C and one without, or one O with each C. Accept unsimplified forms.
$10+30+30+10$ [M1]
Guidance: Add three or four correct included-scenario values with no incorrect scenario; repeated correct scenarios are condoned.
$80$ [A1]
Guidance: Award total $80$.
Method 2 — complement
Excluded cases: CCO/O/rest $=10$; CC/one O/one O $=30$; CC/OO/rest $=20$. [B1]
Guidance: Accurately calculate one identified excluded scenario; accept unsimplified forms.
$140-(10+30+20)$ [M1]
Guidance: From total 140, subtract two or three correct excluded-scenario values with no incorrect scenario.
$80$ [A1]
Guidance: Award total $80$.
